text: Still paying every year just to look at your own database?
Meet Tusk. A faster, native Mac database client. Free and open source.
Connect to twenty databases, from PostgreSQL to MongoDB and Redis.
Browse millions of rows in a GPU-rendered grid that never stutters.
Edit cells, columns and indexes, then save everything in a single transaction.
Write SQL with real language-server completions, and run it with one keystroke.
Or just ask. The AI reads your schema and writes the query into a new tab. You decide when it runs.
Every action is one keystroke away.
Make it yours with over thirty light and dark themes.
Tusk. Free and open source. Download it today.
